title: Princeton Railroad Museum

services.name: Tours and Events
services.desc: We’d love to help you schedule your event here at the Princeton Railroad Museum. We feature the Virginian Railway, but other railroads are represented Including the N&W. We house exhibits of railroad artifacts plus artwork, books, and photographs. A restored #308 Virginian caboose is available for people to explore. we have an area for children where they can build a track. There are puzzles and books. We have a gift shop.
